dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive and symmetrical narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward a pointed posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-to-light bluish-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse tonal variations with subtle darker grey patches concentrated mainly on the lateral-dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; tonal gradients between light and dark grey regions lack defined edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Series of faint, vertically-oriented, parallel linear marks located on the mid-left lateral-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine linear markings, likely rake marks, are visible as low-contrast disruptions on the left side of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharp, well-defined dorsal ridge extending from the mid-dorsal area toward the peduncle.
